hooks.name: Auto-commit on agent completion
hooks.description: Automatically stages and commits all changes when an agent session completes. Builds a descriptive commit message from changed files.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$files = git status --porcelain; if (-not $files) { Write-Output 'Nothing to commit'; exit 0 } $lines = $files -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim() }; $count = $lines.Count; $names = $lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s*','') -replace '.+-> ','') } | ForEach-Object { Split-Path $_ -Leaf }; $summary = ($names | Select-Object -First 3) -join ', '; if ($count -gt 3) { $summary += " (+$($count - 3) more)" }; git add -A; git commit -m "chore(kiro): $summary [$count files]""
